expected: the Jevellan web app "undo retry" screen at desktop-light, rendered completely and legibly (one of several screens captured during "step corrections survive reload and undo launches the requested redo with visible history"; the other steps are judged in their own screenshots)

cosmetic: The error text 'No model can run this step right now: disabled, disabled, disabled, disabled, disabled, disabled.' repeats 'disabled' six times and doesn't name the models, so it's hard to act on. It also appears twice: in the red banner and again in the Resume correction card.

Sidebar conversation titles and subtitles are cut off with ellipses (e.g. 'Change the value to thre…', 'Context · J11 memory journ…'). This is expected truncation in a narrow column; each row stays identifiable.
The 'Step 1 · Implement' heading is struck through, which makes it a little harder to read. This seems intentional to show the step was undone.
